title: BitVM: Compute Anything on Bitcoin
quote: Rather than executing computations on Bitcoin, they are merely verified, similarly to optimistic rollups. ... The main drawback of the model proposed here is that it is limited to the two-party setting with a prover and a verifier.

title: BitVM: Compute Anything on Bitcoin (annotated)
quote: The commitment contains two hashes, hash0 and hash1; the prover reveals a preimage to set a bit to 0 or 1. If both preimages are revealed, this constitutes equivocation and the verifier can seize the deposit. Each logic gate receives its own Taproot script leaf; the resulting on-chain footprint is minimal.

title: BitVM 2: Permissionless Verification on Bitcoin
